item.title: Re: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded: Sadly, direct fan-art of Minions would still be infringing on Illumination's copyright. So I and Alces_alces used what we had. Which is to say, Minions costumes and objects IRL.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Since 8 April, this is showing 14 votes for a total of +6, slightly lower than its overall +/- ratio. So clearly there is a market for something like this outside the bounds of the "contest". The contest as a whole has 32 surviving entries, of which only half have a rating of +10 or higher, and this is the most successful by far (the next most successful consisting of three photographs of a cat, because it wouldn't be the internet otherwise), so I think it might be the only entry that had even a chance of surviving without the contest having prompted it.

item.title: (no title)
